blockingFindings.title: R8 side-effect test does not exercise help rendering
blockingFindings.target: specs/292-command-help-registry/tests/help-metadata-model.test.js: R8: metadata read path does not invoke command run behavior
blockingFindings.issue: The test only calls buildCoreHelpModel(), so it verifies model construction but not help rendering. R8 requires focused tests showing help rendering reads metadata without invoking command run behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Call a renderer path such as renderHelp() or renderCommandHelp() with the fake command metadata and assert the command function was not invoked.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This leaves an acceptance requirement without corresponding spec-local coverage for the actual rendering path.

advisoryFindings.title: Regex escaping helper has a latent incorrect replacement
advisoryFindings.improvement: Replace the escape replacement string with the usual '\\$&' so regex metacharacters in expected fragments are escaped correctly.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: Current expected fragments passed through this helper appear not to depend on escaping metacharacters, so the tests still exercise the intended behavior today.
